revision_record.reason_v2_is_invalid_for_new_cells: The source revision changed after v2 through trajectory lineage/versioning work, an Alloy hash-order determinism fix, a source-migration audit gate, preregistration binding in the batch runner, and a dedicated four-condition analyzer. No nonzero-budget v2 pilot cell may be pooled with v3.

negative_evidence.root_cause: An unversioned portable snapshot projection broke historical report binding, and one analysis used an overbroad historical runtime scope.
Alloy composition-distance reduction iterated over sets, so the trusted host and isolated candidate could differ by last-bit floating-point order under different hash seeds.

negative_evidence.result: Five old hash-seed landscapes collapse to one stabilized landscape; all optimal rows, baseline/reference metrics and four retained proposal sources remain unchanged; three unretained proposal sources remain explicitly unreplayable.

frozen_source.source_change_rule: Any change within source_provenance SOURCE_SCOPE after the frozen revision requires a new preregistration version. Reports produced by a descendant commit are accepted only when git diff over SOURCE_SCOPE is empty.

model_condition.replicate_identifier_limit: The local identifier controls Python/random ordering only; equal identifiers across feedback modes do not share provider-side model randomness.

tasks.scientific_role: active mechanism recovery, prediction, false discovery and unsupported-model refusal
Maxwell-solver nominal design, held-out transfer and sealed fabrication/angle robustness

feedback_semantics.normal: Online strict-improvement parent selection; the prompt sees allowlisted search metrics for the current incumbent.
feedback_semantics.score_only: Online strict-improvement parent selection remains active, but each prompt sees only combined_score; this is a feedback-bandwidth treatment, not a no-feedback control.
feedback_semantics.delayed_replay: Proposal k sees the best valid artifact released only through proposal k-2; observer-side best selection still retains all evaluated candidates.
feedback_semantics.selection_blind: Every proposal receives the frozen baseline artifact and baseline allowlisted metrics; scores affect only observer-side best-of-batch selection.

analysis.configured_horizon: All three proposal slots; report terminal best and charged-budget best-so-far AUC.
analysis.common_token_horizon: For each task and replicate identifier, use the minimum completed provider total-token count among the four conditions. A proposal contributes only after its entire provider call completes. The baseline exists at token zero. Missing, nonintegral, negative or input-plus-output-inconsistent usage fails the analysis; no imputation is allowed.
analysis.science_axis_rule: Keep evaluator-only science axes task-specific. Do not average them into a cross-task discovery score.
analysis.interval_rule: With two uncontrolled local replicate identifiers, Student-t intervals and means are diagnostics only; no significance test, multiplicity claim or population inference is permitted.
analysis.variation_gate: At least one task must have a full-horizon combined-score range of at least 0.01 across the eight cells and at least one interior score strictly between 0.01 and 0.99.

failure_retry_and_stopping.risk_set: Run all 16 scheduled cells regardless of apparent positive, negative or saturated results.
failure_retry_and_stopping.retry: Retain every failed outer attempt. Retry only the same cell with --resume after manifest and checkpoint equality checks; never silently replace history.
failure_retry_and_stopping.terminal_failure: Report completion over the frozen 16-cell denominator plus a paired-completer sensitivity. Candidate invalidity or unparsable output is an outcome, not an exclusion.
failure_retry_and_stopping.fail_closed: Missing trajectory/artifact, manifest/checkpoint mismatch, parent or prompt mismatch, absent selected science axis, incomplete provider usage, prerequisite failure or source/model drift invalidates derived analysis.
failure_retry_and_stopping.stopping: Stop only after all 16 cells have a terminal attempt, or when endpoint/evaluator unavailability prevents execution. Do not stop based on observed outcome direction.

full_test_suite.required: execution_passed=true, unittest_ok=true, trusted_evidence=true, zero failures/errors on frozen-source-equivalent revision

protocol_smoke.required: all four modes x two identifiers complete with schema-v2 snapshots, clean provenance, matching model condition and exact preregistration hash binding

execution_order: Commit this preregistration on top of frozen source ae6090f.
Run and commit feedback protocol smoke v3 with --preregistration binding.
Only then run the 16-cell nonzero-budget pilot.

pilot_may_inform_design_only_if: all 16 terminal cells and all retry history are retained
all four feedback lineage and prompt contracts pass
at least one task passes the preregistered non-saturated variation gate
feedback_claim_still_requires: at least ten independent runs per condition
server-controlled randomness if available or explicit unpaired randomization otherwise
pilot-based precision planning and multiplicity control
independent domain-scientist validation and prospective or orthogonal replication
